title: ZSet 编码切换：listpack 与 skiplist+dict
expected_output:
small zset -> listpack
big-value  -> skiplist+dict
many zset  -> skiplist+dict
code:
ZSET_MAX_ENTRIES = 128
ZSET_MAX_VALUE = 64

def zset_encoding(items):
    n = len(items)
    if n == 0:
        return "listpack"
    if n <= ZSET_MAX_ENTRIES and all(len(m.encode()) <= ZSET_MAX_VALUE for _, m in items):
        return "listpack"
    return "skiplist+dict"

small = [(1, "a"), (2, "b")]
big = [(i, "m%d" % i + "x" * 70) for i in range(5)]
many = [(i, "m%d" % i) for i in range(200)]
print("small zset ->", zset_encoding(small))
print("big-value  ->", zset_encoding(big))
print("many zset  ->", zset_encoding(many))
